notes.title: Patch 1.02 | Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, hope you are enjoying the game. We appreciate your feedback and have updated the builds to fix a critical bug, which made it so that death in the parkour would cause a death loop and not allow you to progress. This should be fixed now.

As always, please leave a review if you have any further questions or any feature requests/bug reports to give us.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 | Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, hope you are enjoying the game. We appreciate your feedback and have updated the builds to fix some bugs, namely


 Made UI fonts more consistent
 Fixed a bug with using hints for puzzles - game no longer freezes
 Fixed interactions with doors - no longer blur out
 Made number lock select faster for easier access
 Fixed a bug related to cutscene movement
 Fixed a bug that allowed players move despite a loading screen being present
 Bird puzzle can be solved with hints, as hints now work


As always, please leave a review if you have any further questions or any feature requests/bug reports to give us.
